TRIXXHome

Control lights, locks, climate and power from one screen.

TRIXX Home is the control room for your house. It reads your solar, watches your tank, arms your cameras and lets you hand a temporary key to a cleaner or a contractor without ever cutting a metal one.

Features

  • ✓Lights, sockets and scenes room by room
  • ✓Live solar generation, battery state and grid draw
  • ✓Camera streams and motion history
  • ✓Digital keys with expiry for staff and guests
  • ✓Automations: sunrise lighting, away mode, water-tank alerts
  • ✓Works offline on the local hub when the internet drops
180+ Devices supported
9 min Average setup time
4.8 / 5 Rating

Platforms

TRIXXFarm

Irrigate on soil moisture, not on guesswork.

TRIXX Farm turns a plot into a managed system. Sensors report moisture at three depths, the controller waters only when the soil asks, and every litre and hour is logged so you can see what the season actually cost.

Features

  • ✓Soil-moisture and temperature sensing at 3 depths
  • ✓Zone irrigation schedules with weather-aware skipping
  • ✓Water and pump-hour accounting per zone
  • ✓Livestock water level and trough monitoring
  • ✓Planting calendar with yield logging
  • ✓Offline schedule that runs without network
up to 41% Water saved
up to 12 hrs/wk Labour saved
16 Zones per controller

Platforms

TRIXXRent

Pay rent, get receipts, log a repair — in three taps.

TRIXX Rent removes the monthly argument. Rent is invoiced, paid by M-Pesa or card, receipted instantly and reconciled against the lease. Maintenance requests carry photos and a status the tenant can follow.

Features

  • ✓Rent invoicing with M-Pesa and card payment
  • ✓Instant digital receipts and running balance
  • ✓Maintenance requests with photos and status tracking
  • ✓Lease documents and renewal reminders
  • ✓Deposit ledger and move-out checklist
  • ✓Landlord and tenant views of the same record
under 30 s Payment settlement
instant Receipt delivery
86% Repairs resolved in 48 h

TRIXXMarket

Buy and sell property with verified people.

TRIXX Market is the listing side of the business. Every owner is identity-checked, every TRIXX-built home carries its build record, and buyers chat directly with the seller instead of through a chain of brokers.

Features

  • ✓Verified owner and agent profiles
  • ✓Search by location, price, style and smart tier
  • ✓Chat with the owner or agent in the app
  • ✓Saved searches with new-match alerts
  • ✓Photo, video and 360 tour on every listing
  • ✓Mortgage and payment calculator in-app

TRIXXSchool

Fees, timetables and reports for parents and schools.

TRIXX School connects a school to its parents. Fees are invoiced and receipted, timetables and results are published to the right guardians only, and announcements reach everyone who needs them without a paper trail.

Features

  • ✓Fee invoicing, M-Pesa payment and receipts
  • ✓Timetable and term calendar
  • ✓Report cards and assessment history
  • ✓Attendance and transport notifications
  • ✓Guardian-only announcements
  • ✓Bursary and payment-plan tracking
